short_description_canonical.en: Discover an exceptional beachfront property at Playa La Perla, Km 67 La Libertad. This rancho features two separate houses, each priced at $445,000, with a total construction area of 400 m² on a 1,092 m² lot (13m front x 84m depth). The first house offers a pool, 2 master bedrooms with private baths, 2 social baths, a spacious living room, modern kitchen with breakfast bar, dining area, and a beautiful terrace with ocean views. The second house has 4 bedrooms, each with private bath, and two terraces—one overlooking the sea and another facing the parking area. Additional amenities include parking for 8 vehicles, electricity and water connections, septic tank, concrete access road, and direct beach access. The beach is ideal for surfing, with 1 km of sand and stunning cliffs. Perfect for a vacation home or tourist investment.

Location and size
Located on the renowned El Espino Beach, in the municipality of Jucuar&aacute;n, department of Usulut&aacute;n, with more than 10 km of coastline, white sand, wide plains, and part of Jiquilisco Bay.
The land covers 5 acres, which is approximately 152,203 sf.
Topography and surroundings
The land is completely flat, which facilitates its development and construction without the need for major earthworks.
It faces the sea, which places it next to the coastline, ideal for panoramic views, direct access to the beach, and project design facing the Pacific.
Services
It is located in an area with accessible services&mdash;this may include electricity, access to drinking water, or the possibility of a well.
Potential and investment
Playa El Espino is part of the Surf City II plan, a tourism strategy promoted in the eastern part of the country, which increases the projected value of the land.
Perfect for vacation or tourism projects such as beach houses, eco-resorts, Airbnb ventures, or even hotel developments.

-7 Piscinas con 7 Casas Club comunes.
